research_hypothesis: An uncertainty-normalized causal run-length posterior over hypothesis grammars can detect an unfamiliar structural-law change without private phase labels, retaining more public observations and exploiting causal invariants better than a fixed eight-observation posterior, while preserving same legal actions and fully matched conventional controls.
native_architecture_prototype: Independent tokenless 16-public-row causal graph posterior that maintains a mixture over run-lengths 4/8/16, internally computes per-mediator rule posteriors over original 45/45/84 public XOR/AND/OR hypotheses and a joint-marginal downstream causal prediction. No transformer/tokenizer, no native model integration.

frozen_mechanism.matched_same_storage: Both arms retain ONLY the most recent 16 public observed x,mediator rows. The candidate updates online from public observations and uses no more information than the fixed16 ablation, original graph_all/graph_recent16 matched baselines, and other fully trained 11 controls.
frozen_mechanism.full_grammar: Exactly the original 45/45/84 operator hypotheses, downstream m2 evaluated using actual OBSERVED m0/m1 when computing public row likelihood, and predicted upstream marginals only for unobserved future x.
frozen_mechanism.likelihood: Per-row independent mediator correctness .9 and mismatch .1, uniform operator prior within each output, no hidden simulator structure or law label.
frozen_mechanism.truncation: For each runlength r use the most recent min(r,observations_available) public rows. No unbounded history.
frozen_mechanism.model_evidence: For every candidate r, sum three output marginal log-likelihoods; for output o, log( sum_h .9^(n-errors_o(h))*.1^(errors_o(h)) / number_of_hypotheses ), plus n*log(2) per output to compare against an iid 0.5-null reference. Prior P(r)=1/3. Softmax via subtract-max. NEVER tune after data.
frozen_mechanism.runlength_posterior: Candidate prediction is runlength-weighted average of each horizon's fully Bayesian posterior predictive P(m0),P(m1),P(m2) using separate operator posteriors; m2 expectation integrates m0,m1 independent Bernoulli marginals, uses original 84 rules and no private formula.
frozen_mechanism.ablation: fixed16_posterior uses identical recent16 public rows, fixed length16 and same posterior structural grammar/likelihood; no mixture/adaptive weighting.
frozen_mechanism.policy: BOTH arms use original unchanged controls.plan 0..2 actual setbit interventions, same .05 action cost and exact public reward STOP, only own actual observed intervention outcomes update posteriors.
frozen_mechanism.memory: Store canonical 16 public (x,m) rows, no raw secrets, hidden law, oracle or derived caches in checkpoint; cold exact restore, no protected A/B slots, no induced first-use learner promotion.
frozen_mechanism.no_prior_retuning: AAI-11A/B/D and their failures stay frozen; this is not a coefficient adjustment to their old learner.

frozen_trial.common_public_training: Original 16 A +16 B exogenous true single-do trials =64 shared public rows for all models, no source phase labels to learner.
frozen_trial.challenge: Original C/D/E/F unfamiliar structural laws, 2/4 exogenous true do-action trials =4/8 public rows; each method restored from own exact A/B post-B checkpoint.
frozen_trial.scored_episodes: 12 unchanged original x/goal contexts per law,budget,fixture, independent cold snapshot per episode; 288 real 0–2 do-action consequence episodes per arm; only selected true do-action feedback observed, never unselected outcomes.
frozen_trial.fixed_baselines: Original fully qualified G 11 conventional controls and original AAI-11D posterior8 (source-only diagnostic) reused without re-running for early stop; original strongest graph_recent8 reward 2.134027778, reachable recovery108/144=.75, unreachable regret .185763889 and familiar A/B 2.210416667; posterior8 mean reward 2.189756944, recovery117/144=.8125.
frozen_trial.screen_logic: ALL conditions must pass; method effect fixed16 is separate ablation; compare original strongest reward, original best conditional recovery, actual reward and unreachable regret as G. If any FAIL, stop after first source-only mechanical screen, no rerun 11 conventional, no detailed science first-use, no posterior odds/horizon/temperature/hazard editing after observing results.
frozen_trial.if_screen_passes: Complete source-only full original 11 conventional plus both candidate/ablation and original posterior8, recompute strongest reward and best recovery, A/B return and matched 2x whole process time vs fastest on each OS, negative controls, then only separately authorize science first-use. Do not call a test fixture scientific proof.
